children: The number of building permits issued in Serbia increased 8.6% year-on-year to 2,751 in July 2026, easing from an 11.3% rise in the previous month.
Building accounted for 83.6% of all permits issued, with 82% intended for residential construction and 18% for non-residential projects.
The remaining 16.4% of permits were for civil engineering projects, the majority of which (73.6%) were related to pipelines, communication networks, and electrical lines.

Meanwhile, a total of 4,292 dwellings were authorized for construction, of which 10% will be built in single-dwelling buildings, while 88.7% will be constructed in buildings with three or more dwellings.
By region, the highest share of planned construction was recorded in the Belgrade region, at 35.5%.

title: Serbia Building Permits Up 8.6% in July
